ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) with approximately 5-8% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution concentrated in speckles and at the basal junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of a contiguous low-intensity dark field; sparse high-intensity white speckles (<10px diameter) are randomly distributed across both lobes; a distinct high-intensity white patch is localized at the lower central junction of the flukes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped indentation with a calculated interior angle of approximately 52 degrees and a depth ratio of 0.25 relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; left lobe (viewer left) exhibits three macro-scale jagged indentations on the medial edge; right lobe (viewer right) displays a continuous micro-serrated sawtooth pattern along the distal trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curvature extending from the notch to the fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density distribution of small, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters across the entirety of the visible dark fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant macro-structural loss/irregularities on the medial trailing edge of the left lobe, appearing as deep, non-uniform notches indicating prior tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white pigmentation band at the insertion point where the fluke lobes meet the peduncle.
